'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twenty-two bodies are recovered from a vessel found adrift off the coast of [[Crete]], [[Greece]], according to the [[Hellenic Coast Guard|Greek coast guard]]. Twenty-six people are rescued by [[Frontex]]. Several survivors said some people were also thrown [[Man overboard|overboard]] into the [[Mediterranean Sea]] on the orders of a [[Human trafficking in Greece|human trafficker]] during the journey. [https://www.reuters.com/world/twenty-two-migrants-die-off-greek-coast-after-six-days-sea-afp-reports-2026-03-28/ (Reuters)]
